subject.title: docs: link canonical kit vision and shared launch direction

question: Should Commerce publicly adopt the proposed shared launch-direction wording after the canonical organization vision and roadmap are merged?
rationale: The change makes cross-repository product direction part of Commerce’s public README, while the discussion contains no maintainer confirmation of the wording or dependency sequencing.

options.title: Approve the dependent documentation
options.body: Merge the organization documents first, then merge this README-only change with the stated scope boundary.

options.title: Keep Commerce documentation self-contained
options.body: Defer the external links until the organization documents are stable or replace them with wording maintained within this repository.

recommendation.title: Approve the dependent documentation
recommendation.body: Merge the organization documents first, then merge this README-only change with the stated scope boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor connected to both the proposed documentation and the current EmDash pilot context.
